name: cold_angle_v1
hypothesis: Opening with what a quiet quote already cost them (survey visit, paperwork) gets more positive replies than opening with a question about how many went quiet.
variable: opening sentence only (subject, offer line, ask and follow-ups = cold_offer_v1 winner)
decision_rule: Superseded for now: the pain opener ('ring back months after a quote') is in cold_offer_v1 for both arms. Rewrite as a new opener test only after cold_offer_v1 is decided. Start only after cold_offer_v1 is decided: replace [OFFER] and the ask with the winning arm's, copy its follow_ups, set status to ready. Run on ~30% of the remaining list. Keep the arm with >= 90% probability of the higher positive-reply rate; otherwise keep the one with more booked calls.

arms.subject: quotes that went quiet
arms.body:
Hi,

How many quotes has {company} sent in the last year where the homeowner just went quiet?

[OFFER]

Worth me explaining how it works?

arms.subject: quotes that went quiet
arms.body:
Hi,

Every quote that goes quiet has already cost {company} a survey visit and an evening of paperwork.

[OFFER]

Worth me explaining how it works?
